[Intro]
[G]
[D]
[G]
[D]

[Verse 1]
[G]When I think of you in the city The
[D]sight of you among the sites I
[G]get this sudden sinking feeling
[D]Of a man about to fly

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]Never kept me up before
[D]Now I’ve been awake for days
[Am]I can’t fight it anymore I’m
[D]going through an awkward phase

[Verse 2]
[G]I am secretly in love with
[D]Everyone that I grew up with
[G]Do my crying underwater
[D]I can’t get down any farther

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]All my drowning friends can see
[D]Now there is no running from
[Am]It’s become the crux of me I
[D]wish that I could rise above it
But I stay

[Chorus]
[G]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[G]down With my
[D]demons

[Verse 2]
[G]Buts and buzzards in the sky
[D]Alligators in the sewers
[G]I don’t even wonder why
[D]Hide among the younger viewers

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]Huddle with them all night long
[D]Worried talk to God goes on
[Am]I sincerely tried to love it
[D]Wish that I could rise above it
But I stay

[Chorus]
[G]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[G]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[Am]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[Am]down With my
[D]demons

[Break]
[Em]Can I stay here? I can sleep,
[D]on the floor
[Em]Paint the blood and hang the palms,
[D]on the door
[Em]Do not think I’m going places
[D]anymore I
[Em]wanna see the sun come up
[D]on New York Oh,

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]everyday I start so great
[D]Then the sunlight dims
[Am]Less I look The more I see the
[D]pythons in the limbs
[Am]Do not know what’s wrong with me The
[D]sour is in the cut
[Am]When I walk into a room I
[D]do not light it up
Fuck So I stay

[Chorus]
[Em]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[Em]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[Am]down With my
[D]demons I stay
[Am]down With my
[D]demons

[Outro]
[Em]
